title: Writing Summaries is More Important Than Reading More Books

cards.prompt: Explain like I'm 10: why does writing a summary of a book help you understand it better than just reading more books?
cards.answer: Writing makes you remember and rebuild what you read in your own words. That makes you read more carefully.

cards.prompt: What is the first question in the book summary template?
cards.answer: In 1–2 sentences, what is the book about as a whole?

cards.prompt: The summary template asks for ____ central questions the book tries to answer.
Put the summary template steps in order.
items: Describe the whole book in 1–2 sentences
Summarize each answer in a paragraph
Write the most important personal lessons
cards.answer: Overall idea, central questions, answers, then personal takeaways.

cards.prompt: If your goal is to maximize comprehension, what is more valuable?
options: Reading as many books as possible
cards.answer: Writing summaries, since they force recall and reconstruction.

cards.prompt: A friend reads 50 books a year but can barely remember them. What habit would you suggest and why?
cards.answer: Write a summary of each book using a template (overall idea, central questions, answers, personal lessons) because it forces recall and deliberate reading.
